task.title: Provision storage and write the storage layer
task.description:
## Why
Workers have no disk. Everything the CLI keeps in `cache/` and `out/` needs a shared home.

## Steps
1. Create an R2 bucket for large files: league seasons, the player database, values and snapshots, benchmarks and finished reports.
2. Create a D1 database for report jobs and benchmark requests, with migrations kept in `web/migrations/`.
3. Write `web/scripts/provision.sh`, which creates every resource by name with Wrangler and can be re-run safely. The same script will set up the team account later.
4. Write a small storage interface with an R2 and D1 version for production and an in-memory version for tests.
5. Add the bindings to the Wrangler config.

## Done when
- Running `provision.sh` on an empty account creates everything the app needs.
- A deployed test route can write and read back an object and a database row.
